note: Monday Nov 9 card: 3 late games, so a short card of 6 singles (max 3 a game) and 1 parlay; nothing was padded to reach 10. AGREED (named by all three agents and accepted by all three): Evan Bouchard over 0.5 points. Vancouver +1.5 and San Jose +1.5 are in all three agents' top-4 lists, but Agents 2 and 3 only rate them fun only, so they are marked Fun only. LESSONS APPLIED: no points or shots unders on Vancouver players (they face a team on the 2nd night of a back-to-back, Nov 6/7 lessons); Sanheim and Ekholm points unders left off (top-minute defencemen, Sanheim also faces the slate's worst defence, Nov 6/8 lessons); Edmonton moneyline left off so only one pick needs Edmonton's offence (Nov 8 lesson); NYI-SJS under 6.5 and NYR +1.5 skipped (OT risk at 6.5; Edmonton has won by 2+ in 10 of 18); Vancouver +1.5 estimate capped at the Pinnacle number because the model was 10+ points higher (Nov 7 lesson); below-break-even fillers (Horvat, Pettersson, Islanders team total, shots unders) dropped after two agents passed (Nov 8 lesson). NOT ON THE CARD: Under 7.5 NYI@SJS was the highest-chance bet on the slate (about 76%) but Pinnacle has it at -304, just past Steve's -300 limit (bet365 has it at -290). DeAngelo points under excluded for a role flag (ice time up to 20 minutes with Pulock and Romanov out); Nugent-Hopkins props excluded (played only 6:38 on Nov 7). BACK-TO-BACK (2nd night): Philadelphia only. GOALIES: Garand (NYR, confirmed), Levi (EDM, confirmed), Woll (PHI, RotoWire confirmed), Merilainen (VAN, RotoWire confirmed), Sorokin (NYI, expected), Askarov (SJS, confirmed). Injuries: Shesterkin, Durzi IR and Smits out (NYR); Dach out (EDM); Ristolainen IR (PHI); Willander out, Chytil and Demko IR (VAN); Pulock out, Barzal, Maccelli, Romanov IR (NYI); Couture, Chernyshov IR (SJS). Power-play units from RotoWire. Analysts: Covers only (Dimers and TheSpread not checked today). Excluded by Steve's rules: goals props, assists unders, anything shorter than -300, whole-number totals. 374 Pinnacle markets read, 61 allowed options priced. Pinnacle prices re-checked 4:37 PM ET (NYR-EDM under 7.5 moved -263 to -262); bet365 read about 4:30 PM ET.
